messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A capable but verbose architect definition with clear delegation triggers; it needs tighter output contracts, explicit boundaries, and less boilerplate.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names architecture design, technology selection, and ADR creation, giving the main agent enough trigger keywords to route work, though it lacks explicit handoff conditions.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: The role and process are well defined, but the output contract is loose—no required ADR/design-doc format or concrete templates—and it defers details to an external README.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: The prompt has almost no explicit prohibitions or hand-back criteria, so it does not prevent the subagent from drifting into implementation or making unapproved changes.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The frontmatter description is concise, but the body repeats generic principles and checklists, making it longer than needed for a subagent prompt.

suggestions: Add explicit prohibitions against implementation and unapproved changes, plus clear hand-back criteria, to the boundaries section of the architect subagent prompt.
Replace the loose output contract with a mandatory ADR/design-doc format that includes concrete templates and required sections instead of deferring details to an external README.
Remove repeated generic principles and checklists from the prompt body and keep only unique, task-specific instructions to improve conciseness.
